summary: Iteration 22: fixed-cost (overhead) allocation by revenue ratio. Backend: 8/8 pytest pass after one fix (GET defaults, auto revenue = last 30d sales+incomes all restaurants matches DB, PUT with X-Restaurant all, ratio 30%, negative -> 422, blank names dropped, manual->auto fallback, member 403, product-costs adana: overhead 159 / full 259 / net profit 271 / net margin 51.1 / suggested_with_overhead 2000, None when target+ratio >= 100%). Frontend: overhead panel opens by default when total 0 and stays closed when total > 0, defaults listed, live total/ratio preview, add/remove rows, save -> toast + header %30 + table updates (cost-overhead 159 tam 259, cost-margin 51,1 malzeme 81,1, cost-suggested 2.000), 'Sabit giderle zarar eden' tile, calculator (calc-suggested 2.000 with 30% overhead, calc-real-margin 60,0), print-all window contains 'Sabit gider payı' and 'Tam maliyet'.

minor.issue: FIXED by tester: floating-point bug. 1 - 0.65 - 0.30 = 0.04999..., so math.ceil(100/room) returned 2001 instead of 2000. Changed to math.ceil(round(cost / room, 6)). The same fix was made in the frontend CostCalculator (Math.ceil(Number((total/room).toFixed(6)))). suggested_price() (line ~824) has the same pattern and can hit the same edge case.

summary.losing and the 'En düşük net marj' tile only count products that have a recipe. Products with only a manual cost (like adana, cost 100) are left out, so the tiles show '0 / 1' and '—' even though adana has a net margin. The spec says losing = every product with net_profit < 0. Decide whether manual-cost products should be counted.

ui_bugs.issue: When suggested_with_overhead is null (target margin + overhead ratio >= ~99%), the UI falls back to suggested_price, which leaves the overhead out. The suggested price shown looks normal but is misleading. It should show '—' or a 'not possible' note.
When margin + ratio is too high (for example 75% + 30%), calc-suggested shows ₺0,00 with no explanation.

issues: The amount inputs (overhead-amount-i) sit inside a label with color: var(--muted), so typed values like 60000 show in light grey and look like placeholders. Add color: var(--ink) or #1e293b to .overhead-item input.
In overhead-ratio-preview and calc-real-margin, the '%' sign is large and the number is small ('%30,0'), which looks unbalanced.

design_issues.issue_note: For manual-cost products without a recipe, the Malzeme maliyeti column shows only '+ Sorularla tarif ekle' and hides the manual cost (100). The 'tam ₺259' figure next to it is then hard to understand.
issues: Show the manual cost next to the add-recipe link

action_items: Review the float-precision fix in with_overhead and CostCalculator, and apply the same rounding to suggested_price()
Decide whether summary.losing and worst-margin should include manual-cost products
Show '—' instead of falling back to suggested_price when suggested_with_overhead is null, and explain the ₺0 in the calculator
Fix the low-contrast text in the overhead amount inputs
critical_code_review_comments: overhead_info sums auto revenue in Python over every sales/incomes doc from the last 30 days, on every /product-costs call. A Mongo $group aggregation would be cheaper as data grows.
OverheadPanel copies info into state only on mount, so a stale state is possible if another user edits the values. Acceptable for now.
